title: A city built for walking
text: Pontevedra, in north-west Spain, has done something radical: it has {{1}} banished cars from its centre. Since the reform, traffic accidents have fallen {{2}} zero in the pedestrian zone, and air quality has improved dramatically. Businesses feared losing customers; in fact, footfall rose, {{3}} people linger and shop when streets are calm. Not {{4}} is pleased, of course. Drivers from outside the city complain bitterly, and deliveries require special permits. The mayor argues {{5}} the needs of pedestrians must come first in a city centre, {{6}} most people are, simply, on foot. Other Spanish towns are now copying the model, {{7}} similar schemes in Pontevedra being studied abroad. It proves, its supporters say, that streets designed {{8}} people rather than vehicles are not nostalgia — they work.
